test_select_by_col_list: test the select method with column list and aggregation expressions on a LazyFrame
test_select_args_kwargs: test the select method with positional arguments, keyword arguments, lists, and mixed inputs
test_select_empty: test the select function with no arguments returns an empty DataFrame
test_select_none: test the select function with None literal produces a DataFrame with a None column
test_select_none_combined: test the select function combining None with other expressions in any order
test_select_empty_list: test the select function with an empty list returns an empty DataFrame
test_select_named_inputs_reserved: test the select function with named inputs like inputs and structify
test_select_duplicate_name: test the select method raises DuplicateError when duplicate output names are produced
